name: After dark: a quiet delivery
offerText: Come closer. I have a quiet job for you.
description: Dusan Markovic needs a sealed parts parcel from the new crate beside the Living District barracks. Collect it at night, then return it to him. He works at the factory in the morning and afternoon.

stages.description: At night, collect the Parts parcel from the crate beside the Living District barracks.
Return to Dusan Markovic and hand over the Parts parcel.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Dusan uses a minor after-dark pickup to test whether the player can be trusted.
implementationNotes: Preserve existing loot target and recipient.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
